scientific_integrity: The family is infinitely divisible by its compound-Poisson representation. Mean, variance, the lattice event, and its probability are derived exactly. The bundled numerical script only replays these identities and is not used as a proof. Originality remains subject to the possibility of an older equivalent observation under Hermite, stuttering-Poisson, or lattice-concentration terminology.
scientific_limitations: The result improves the explicit upper bound for the closed one-standard-deviation infimum over infinitely divisible laws but does not determine the exact infimum. It uses a two-jump Hermite/compound-Poisson family and does not provide a matching lower bound.
title: A Hermite perturbation lowers the closed one-sigma infinitely-divisible bound to \(e^{-1}\)
